description: Retail and institutional investors trade against three AI market makers, the GLFT benchmark and a momentum bot. A ledger records what each investor class pays per trade (spread, fees, tax) and what it loses against fair value. Variants swap the AI makers for competitive ones or change the exchange's rules.

variants.name: competitive_makers
variants.label: Competitive makers (Nash policy)
variants.change: The three AI makers are replaced by makers quoting the competitive (Nash) policy for this market: half-spread 4.9, skew 1.2 (seeds 101-103 give 4.5-5.3).

variants.name: maker_rebate
variants.label: Maker rebate
variants.change: Makers earn a 2 bps rebate; takers pay 3 bps.

variants.name: tick_x5
variants.label: Tick size ×5
variants.change: Minimum price increment of 5 cents instead of 1.

variants.name: transaction_tax
variants.label: Transaction tax (5 bps)
variants.change: A 5 bps financial transaction tax on both sides of every trade.

variants.name: short_sale_ban
variants.label: Short-sale ban
variants.change: Nobody but market makers may sell more than they own (the informed trader included).
